name: fbiommumode3
purpose: soak: HW mode 3, every eligible layer through the IOMMU, for the whole boot
config: modes=3 iommu=3 period=0 delay=60 pool=1 probe=1
needs: a kernel with 0401 (kern.n2fbiommu*) on 0394..0400 -- e.g. q10jfj + 0401; without 0401 the iommu lines log rc=2 and the fbhw schedule still runs
